name: IoA's Big Coasters
intro: No theme park in Florida has a coaster lineup that punches as consistently hard as Islands of Adventure. These four represent genuinely different coaster experiences — a launched multi-inversion B&M powerhouse, a 70 mph marquee launch coaster, a magical-creatures adventure that defies easy categorization, and a family coaster that earns its lift-hill view.

rides.blurb: The park's founding coaster and still its most reliably satisfying — the launch into a zero-G roll is one of the great coaster openings in Florida. Front row in morning light is the move.
IoA's current headline act — two launches, 70 mph, four inversions, and a lagoon-skimming barrel roll that's become the park's defining postcard moment.
Technically a launched coaster, but that label barely captures what Hagrid's is — seven launches, live creatures, a backwards spike, and enough theming to justify the wait.
Short — 66 seconds, 29 mph — but the lift-hill view of Hogwarts Castle is legitimately beautiful and the line moves faster than anything else in Hogsmeade.
